stories.title: Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says

en.title: Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
en.summary: The US Defence Secretary announced that the execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, allowing public access to watch the event.

stories.title: Hegseth says execution of Fort Hood shooter will be a public event

en.title: Hegseth says execution of Fort Hood shooter will be a public event
en.summary: The Pentagon Secretary stated that Nidal Hasan, an army psychiatrist who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, will face execution by firing squad as a public event that will be livestreamed later this year.

stories.title: Hegseth says firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed

en.title: Hegseth says firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
en.summary: The Defence Secretary confirmed that the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be a public event that will be livestreamed.

stories.title: Two Latvian men arrested at RAF base in Cambridgeshire used by US military

en.title: Two Latvian men arrested at RAF base in Cambridgeshire used by US military
en.summary: Two Latvian men aged 32 and 36 were arrested at RAF Molesworth after being found inside the military base perimeter on suspicion of trespass, criminal damage, and entering a prohibited area.

stories.title: Polls close in Holborn and St Pancras byelection as Labour hopes to retain seat

en.title: Polls close in Holborn and St Pancras byelection as Labour hopes to retain seat
en.summary: Voting has concluded in the Holborn and St Pancras byelection, where Labour seeks to hold the north London constituency previously represented by Keir Starmer. The contest is viewed as a test of whether party leadership can maintain voter support against competition from the Green party candidate.

stories.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed

en.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed
en.summary: The Pentagon announced that the execution of Fort Hood shooting perpetrator Nidal Malik Hasan by firing squad will be publicly broadcast, following a statement from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth regarding public access to the proceeding.

stories.title: 45 serving officers suspended from major police force over alleged violence against women and girls

en.title: 45 serving officers suspended from major police force over alleged violence against women and girls
en.summary: A major police force has suspended 45 active officers pending investigations into allegations of violence against women and girls, according to the chief constable.

stories.title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire

en.title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
en.summary: Police detained two Latvian nationals inside the perimeter of an RAF base in Cambridgeshire early in the morning on suspicion of trespassing.

stories.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says

en.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
en.summary: A court ruled that warrants authorizing searches of the former prince's residences were unlawful, though a criminal investigation remains ongoing and seized material is retained.

stories.title: Search warrants used in Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor raids were unlawful, court rules

en.title: Search warrants used in Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor raids were unlawful, court rules
en.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor successfully challenged Thames Valley police in court over the legality of search warrants used to raid his home. The court found technical errors in how the warrants were obtained, though this is unlikely to change the investigation's outcome.

stories.title: Forty-five Scottish police officers suspended over alleged crimes against women, says chief constable

en.title: Forty-five Scottish police officers suspended over alleged crimes against women, says chief constable
en.summary: The chief constable of Scottish police reported that 45 officers have been suspended amid allegations of crimes against women. Additional officers are expected to face action as part of a re-vetting process.

stories.title: ‘Entitled’ ex-police chief guilty of gross misconduct over affairs with junior officers

en.title: 'Entitled' ex-police chief guilty of gross misconduct over affairs with junior officers
en.summary: A misconduct panel found that Scott Chilton, the former chief constable of Hampshire and the Isle of Wight, engaged in sexual relationships with subordinate officers, including during times when on call for major incidents. He was barred from serving as a police officer again.

stories.title: US justice department orders playbook refresh for frauds on government

en.title: US justice department orders playbook refresh for frauds on government
en.summary: The US justice department has instructed prosecutors to use all available enforcement powers to recover funds from government fraud cases and pursue longer sentences for offenders.

stories.title: OpenAI annualised revenues $20bn less than previously signalled

en.title: OpenAI annualised revenues $20bn less than previously signalled
en.summary: OpenAI informed investors in September that its annualized revenues were approaching $50 billion, substantially lower than the $70 billion figure that had been widely reported.

stories.title: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal

en.title: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal
en.summary: Starbucks has considered acquiring Chipotle, a burrito chain with a $41 billion market value, which would represent the largest restaurant acquisition in history.

stories.title: Trump says US ‘will not be attacking Iran’ before midterm elections

en.title: Trump says US 'will not be attacking Iran' before midterm elections
en.summary: Trump stated that the United States will not attack Iran before the midterm elections, noting that Washington and Tehran are engaged in productive talks.

stories.title: Microsoft banned from sponsoring foreign workers for US residency

en.title: Microsoft banned from sponsoring foreign workers for US residency
en.summary: The White House has barred Microsoft from sponsoring foreign workers for US residency, marking another measure to restrict immigration affecting multiple technology companies.
